company.name: Litnerd
company.shortDescription: Litnerd brings the creator economy to traditional K-12 education, offering a cohort based reading and SEL program to schools.
company.description: Litnerd brings the creator economy to traditional K-12 education. Litnerd offers a cohort based reading and SEL program where performers bring books to life, turning classrooms into immersive experiences. Litnerd is a contracted vendor with the New York City Department of Education and they're currently serving over 14,000 students.  Litnerd's goal is to help students fall in love with learning through storytelling and to provide the highest quality resources for students and teachers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 92.31% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,826,634 to $9,748,671, a 3.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 57 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-12).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
